fedfunds.label: Effective federal funds rate
fedfunds.source: FRED DFF, Board of Governors via the St. Louis Fed. Effective rate, not the target range.

headlineInflation.label: Headline PCE inflation
headlineInflation.source: FRED PCEPI, BEA personal consumption expenditures price index. Year-over-year change in the index.

coreInflation.label: Core PCE inflation
coreInflation.source: FRED PCEPILFE, BEA PCE price index excluding food and energy. The Phillips curve uses this print.

unemployment.label: Unemployment rate
unemployment.source: FRED UNRATE, BLS civilian unemployment rate, seasonally adjusted.
unemployment.detail: Shown as an observable. The curves use the output gap, not an unemployment gap.

realGdp.label: Real GDP
realGdp.source: FRED GDPC1, BEA real gross domestic product.

potentialGdp.label: CBO potential GDP
potentialGdp.source: FRED GDPPOT, Congressional Budget Office potential GDP.
potentialGdp.detail: Latest observation on or before 2026-10-14. Rows after that date run through 2036 and are not used. The output gap uses potential in the GDP quarter, 2026-04-01.

outputGap.label: Output gap
outputGap.source: Calculated from FRED GDPC1 and GDPPOT for the same quarter.
outputGap.detail: 100 × (24408.011 / 24070.9386484 − 1) on 2026-04-01. Potential on that date is 24070.9386484. The later potential print dated 2026-10-01 is not in this ratio.

tips10.label: 10-year TIPS yield
tips10.source: FRED DFII10, 10-year Treasury inflation-indexed constant maturity.
tips10.detail: Market real long rate. The model moves it with r* and the term-premium shock.

breakeven.label: 10-year breakeven inflation
breakeven.detail: Blank rows in the file are skipped. This is the market print. It is not forced to equal the ACM yield minus the TIPS yield.

realPolicy.label: Real policy rate
realPolicy.source: Calculated: effective federal funds rate minus core PCE inflation.
realPolicy.detail: 3.88 dated 2026-10-12 minus core PCE of 3.0075959761856064 through 2026-08-01. Expected inflation in the IS curve is held at that core print.

rstar.label: Holston–Laubach–Williams r*
rstar.source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Holston–Laubach–Williams current estimates, United States, one-sided. Final data point on the sheet: 2026Q2.
rstar.detail: US natural rate in the HLW workbook, 1.009 percent rounded to 1.01 on the chart. The same sheet's US output gap is −0.11 percent. The curves use the BEA/CBO gap instead.

acmYield.label: ACM 10-year yield
acmYield.source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Adrian–Crump–Moench daily term premium, series ACMY10.
acmYield.detail: Fitted 10-year zero-coupon yield. It equals the risk-neutral yield plus the term premium on the same day. The reference folder has no DGS10 file, so this is the nominal 10-year the model moves.

expectedPath.label: ACM expected path
expectedPath.source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Adrian–Crump–Moench, series ACMRNY10 (risk-neutral 10-year yield).
expectedPath.detail: The expectations component of the ACM 10-year yield.

termPremium.label: ACM 10-year term premium
termPremium.source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Adrian–Crump–Moench, series ACMTP10.
termPremium.detail: ACMY10 − ACMRNY10 on 9 October 2026. The two components add to the fitted yield.

boardParYield.label: Board 10-year par yield
boardParYield.source: Federal Reserve Board yield curve (Gürkaynak, Sack, and Wright), SVENPY10, from the saved yield-curve file.
boardParYield.detail: Coupon-equivalent 10-year par yield. The file is a fitted yield curve. It does not contain a Kim–Wright term premium. The term-premium split uses ACM.
